name: Missing Partition — Target Partition Does Not Exist
description: The pipeline attempts to load data into a date-partitioned target table, but the partition for the current date has not been created yet. The load fails with a 'no partition found' error.

ground_truth_rca_elements: partition creation job did not run ahead of data arrival
150,000 rows for 2026-08-15 could not be loaded
expected_remediation: CREATE TABLE fact_events_20260815 PARTITION OF fact_events FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-08-15') TO ('2026-08-16')
Implement automatic partition creation job that runs daily before ETL pipelines
Add pre-load check: verify target partitions exist for all dates in extracted data
Consider using pg_partman for automatic partition management
